about_the_game:
Welcome to Zekertune, where every beat matters and every melody tells a story!

Dive into an immersive and vibrant world of music with Zekertune, a rhythm game designed to test your precision, reflexes, and love for music. Whether you're a beginner just discovering the genre or a hardcore veteran seeking the ultimate challenge, Zekertune offers a satisfying experience for everyone.

FEEL THE RHYTHM, MASTER THE MUSIC

Zekertune’s core gameplay is simple to learn but incredibly hard to master. Notes will fall from the top of the screen, and your task is to hit the right keys at the perfect time to create beautiful harmony. Chain long combos to multiply your score and fill up your “Zekert Gauge” to unleash an explosive score fever! Every song is a journey, and only those with perfect synchronization will reach the top of the leaderboard.

KEY FEATURES

🎵 Extensive & Diverse Music Library
Enjoy a growing collection tracks from various genres including EDM, J-Pop, Rock, DJ Remixes, Acoustic, and more.

🎹 Intuitive & Responsive Gameplay System
With precise controls and clear visual feedback, you’ll feel every beat. Adjust note speed, offset, and other settings to create the most comfortable gameplay experience for you.

💥 Dynamic Challenges for Everyone
From the relaxing Easy mode to the finger-burning Zekert-Master difficulty. Zekertune ensures there's always a new challenge waiting. Complete songs to unlock higher difficulty levels and hidden charts!

🎨 Note Skins
Make Zekertune truly yours! Unlock and choose from a variety of note skins, visual note effects.

🏆 Global Leaderboards
Compete with friends and players from around the world! Prove your skill by climbing to the top of the leaderboard for each song and difficulty level. Who is the ultimate Tuner?

Are you ready to prove your skills and become a rhythm legend?
Add Zekertune to your Wishlist now and get ready to play!

name: Zekertune

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD FX-8120
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750 4GB, Radeon RX 460 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600H
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1070 8 GB, Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
